title: SCHC Ack-Always fragmentation mode
description:
src/fragment/ack_always.rs behind #[cfg(feature = "ack-always")]:
- AckAlwaysSender: like ACK-on-Error but ACK required after every window
- AckAlwaysReceiver: send ACK after each complete window
- Simpler than ACK-on-Error (no speculative completion)
- ~200 lines, can share bitmap logic with ACK-on-Error via internal module
